brazil-2004.notes: Moved here from south-america-2004. Heading says 'South America Programming Contest' with São Paulo; catalogue has this as the Brazil sub-region contest with many locations. Only source 2 has a copy.

sources.evidence: Page headed 'The 2004 ACM South America Programming Contest, São Paulo, Brazil, November 13, 2004, Final Standings' with 32 team rows and per-problem attempts and times.

brazil-2017.notes: Check: the board has 10 problems A-J while the catalogue lists 13 problems A-M for brazil-2017, and it is the Latin America (all countries) board, not a Brazil-only one; the catalogue said it is the same contest. Could not confirm from the copy alone that it belongs to the Brazil finals. Only source 3 has a copy.

sources.evidence: A 12-page printout headed 'BOCA LATAM ACM ICPC November 2017 - Posted on Friday, Dec 1, 2017, Updated Final Scoreboard' with 442 ranked team rows and problem columns A to J.

brazil-2018.notes: Page gives 9 and 10 November 2018 for the final; the contest day is not said. Not a full standings table: only medal teams and regional champions in text.

sources.evidence: The page announces the medal-winning teams, the regional champions and lists the thirteen problems A to M with authors, but holds no table of all teams.

brazil-2020.notes: Cover date July 10, 2021 differs from catalogue 2021-07-08. Cover lists the Latin American set shared by many countries.

sources.evidence: The PDF cover reads 2020 Latin American Regional Contests with a contest session of 14 problems, headed A Almost Origami to N Non-Integer Donuts, matching the catalogue's list.
The PDF cover reads 2021 Latin American Regional Contests, Contest Session, April 2, 2022, with 13 problems A to M from Ancient Towers to Most Ordered Way.
